slides.2.title: Wiener Gemischter Satz DAC (2013)
slides.2.highlights.0.title: Co-planted and co-fermented
slides.2.highlights.0.content: Several varieties planted together in one vineyard, harvested and fermented together (a field blend)
slides.2.highlights.1.title: Variety proportions
slides.2.highlights.1.content: At least three white varieties; the largest may not exceed 50% and the third must be at least 10%
slides.2.highlights.2.title: Alcohol
slides.2.highlights.2.content: Klassik at most 12.5% abv; Ried wines at least 12.5% abv
slides.2.content: Note the direction: Klassik is a cap and Ried is a floor.
What is the cap on the dominant variety in Wiener Gemischter Satz?
The dominant variety may not exceed 50%, and the third must be at least 10%.
In which year was Wiener Gemischter Satz DAC created?
Wiener Gemischter Satz became a DAC in 2013.
What is the defining feature of a Gemischter Satz?
A. Varieties vinified separately then blended
B. Varieties co-planted and fermented together
Gemischter Satz is a co-planted field blend, harvested and fermented together.
